But the tool expects budget_limit in USD. The user says "not do visible currency conversion, ensuring you stay within 20,000 RMB equivalent." So we need to convert 20,000 RMB to USD. There's a tool compute_exchange_rate that can compute exchange rate between two currencies. We need to call compute_exchange_rate with base_currency=RMB, target_currency=USD, value=20000. Then we get the converted amount. Then we call set_budget_limit with access_token='abc123xyz', budget_limit=converted_amount. So we need to call compute_exchange_rate first.
